questions.prompt: Which shape has 4 equal sides and 4 right angles?

choices.feedback: A rectangle has 4 right angles but not necessarily 4 equal sides.
A triangle has 3 sides, not 4.
A circle has no sides or right angles.

hints: A square has 4 equal sides and 4 right angles.
A rectangle has 4 right angles but opposite sides are equal.
A square is a special type of rectangle.
Check: all sides equal + all angles 90°.
questions.explanation: A square has 4 equal sides and 4 right angles.

questions.prompt: How many sides does a triangle have?

choices.feedback: A square has 4 sides. A triangle has 3 sides.
A pentagon has 5 sides.
A hexagon has 6 sides.

hints: A triangle is a shape with 3 straight sides.
Think: 'tri' means three.
Examples: slices of pizza, road signs (yield signs).
Count the sides: 1, 2, 3.

questions.prompt: Which shape has exactly one pair of parallel sides?

choices.feedback: A square has two pairs of parallel sides.
A rectangle has two pairs of parallel sides.
A circle has no sides or parallel lines.

hints: A pair of parallel sides runs in the same direction without meeting.
A trapezium has only one pair of parallel sides.
Think: 'trapezium' sounds like 'table' — a table has one top edge parallel to the bottom.
A square and rectangle have two pairs of parallel sides.
questions.explanation: A trapezium has exactly one pair of parallel sides.

questions.prompt: Why does a square always have four right angles?

choices.text: A square is defined as a shape with 4 equal sides and 4 right angles
All squares are made of triangles
choices.feedback: A square is defined by 4 equal sides and 4 right angles.

choices.text: Squares are drawn with rulers only
choices.feedback: The definition comes from its properties, not the tools used.

choices.text: Only squares can have right angles
choices.feedback: Rectangles also have 4 right angles. The key is that a square has 4 equal sides AND 4 right angles.

hints: A square is a special type of rectangle.
Rectangles have 4 right angles.
A square adds the rule of 4 equal sides.
So a square always has 4 right angles.
questions.explanation: A square is defined as a shape with 4 equal sides and 4 right angles.

questions.prompt: Which shape has 3 sides and 3 vertices (corners)?

choices.feedback: A square has 4 sides and 4 vertices.
A circle has no vertices.
A rectangle has 4 sides and 4 vertices.

hints: A triangle has 3 sides and 3 vertices.
Think: 'tri' means three.
Draw a triangle: count the sides (3) and the corners (3).
Triangle is the simplest polygon (closed shape with straight sides).
questions.explanation: A triangle has 3 sides and 3 vertices.

questions.prompt: A rectangle has a length of 8 cm and a width of 5 cm. What is its perimeter?

choices.feedback: 8 + 5 = 13 is only half the perimeter. Perimeter = 2 × (8 + 5) = 26 cm.
40 cm would be the area (8 × 5 = 40), not the perimeter.
8 + 5 = 13, and 13 × 2 = 26. 46 cm is incorrect.

hints: Perimeter = 2 × (length + width).
Length = 8 cm, width = 5 cm.
The unit is cm, not cm² (area).

questions.prompt: Which quadrilateral has 4 equal sides, 4 right angles, and 2 pairs of parallel sides?

choices.feedback: A rectangle has 4 right angles and 2 pairs of parallel sides, but not 4 equal sides.
A rhombus has 4 equal sides and 2 pairs of parallel sides, but not 4 right angles.
A kite has 2 pairs of adjacent equal sides but not 4 right angles or 4 equal sides.

hints: The shape must have ALL of: 4 equal sides, 4 right angles, 2 pairs of parallel sides.
A square has all three properties.
Check each option against the criteria.
A rectangle lacks 4 equal sides. A rhombus lacks 4 right angles.
questions.explanation: A square has 4 equal sides, 4 right angles, and 2 pairs of parallel sides.

questions.prompt: Which shape does NOT belong with the others: square, rectangle, triangle, rhombus?

choices.feedback: A square has 4 equal sides and 4 right angles. It belongs with the others (quadrilaterals).
A rectangle has 4 sides and 4 right angles. It belongs with the others (quadrilaterals).
A rhombus has 4 sides and is a quadrilateral. It belongs with the others.

hints: Look at the properties of each shape.
A square, rectangle, and rhombus all have 4 sides (they are quadrilaterals).
A triangle has only 3 sides.
The triangle does not belong because it has 3 sides, not 4.
questions.explanation: The triangle does not belong because it has 3 sides, while the others have 4 sides (quadrilaterals).
